name: elastic-orbit-loader
title: Elastic Orbit Loader
description: A celestial loading spinner featuring multi-satellite nodes orbiting an elliptical nucleus with gravitational acceleration at periapsis and spring-tethered lag.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Continuous Playback: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
